facility.name: Starting Point Childrens Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 11025 RANCHSTONE DR, HOUSTON, TX, 77064

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant 1 classroom had 1 caregiver with 6 children ages 9 months through 23 months: with a specified age range of 12-17 months. The classroom was over ratio by one child. Ratio needs to be 1:5.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Child has been enrolled for over a year, child was enrolled in 4/18/2024 and did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant two classroom was out of ratio for nap time, there was one caregiver specified age ground 12-17 months old, the caregiver was three over the ratio for 1 to 5 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The health inspection was last conducted on 2-6-2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation las fire inspection was conducted on 6-18-2025, over a year ago.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two children did not have an emergency contact beside a parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: One of the drivers and director did not have transportation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the inspection of the school age room I observed a wall with large area of paint peeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the walkthrough I observed mold on a wall in the preschool room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director was found not to have been ensuring the operation was operating in compliance with minimum standards when she taped a piece of paper over a hole with mold in the preschool classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: During the walkthrough of the upstairs school age room, I observed a crack in the ceiling sheetrock.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License: During review of personnel records 2 out of 10 records evaluated did not have a copy of current driver's license for caregivers providing transportation services.     This was corrected when the director made copies and placed them in the file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: During review of record keeping 1 out of 10 records evaluated did not have current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach: The operation has a water hose on the toddler s playground and is accessible to the children.      Note: This was corrected when the director stored the water hose away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.5015(c))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: The Pre-K and School-age classroom has cleaning products stored under the sink cabinet that is accessible to the children with no locking mechanism.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The infant classroom first aid kit was missing tape, scissors, thermometer, and tweezer.  Note: This was corrected when the director added the items in the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: The toddler one classroom was missing a safety outlet cover.  Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director replaced the outlet covers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The parent handbook does not inform parents of the benefits of physical activity and outdoor play, the duration of phys cai activity and outdoor play, types of physical activities the children will participate in, the setting of the activities, the criteria used when there is extreme weather and the plan for children to still receive physical activity when weather prevents them from going outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The First Aid Kit in one van did not have Band-Aids or antiseptic solution/wipes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Of the 10 personnel records evaluated, 7 have not completed 24 clock hours of pre-service training. These staff are being counted in the child/staff ratio. Additionally, one staff that just started on the day of the inspection was counted in the child/staff ratio without the 8 clock hours of pre-service training being completed. This staff needs to complete the 8 clock hours of pre-service training by 10/16/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one did not include the results of a vision and hearing screening.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver is not washing their hands with running water and soap after diaper changes,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services: The parent handbook does not inform parents of the procedures that will take place for inclusive child care for any child with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: All 10 of the children's records lacked information regarding special needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, five were behind with immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training: The director has not completed a Transportation Safety training course.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, three lacked a health care statement,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: The director received 6 of the 30 clock hours of required annual training for the March 2022-March 2023 training year. The director will need to receive 24 clock hours of make-up training that will not count towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one record lacked the original exemption form for the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Of the 9 personnel records evaluated, 7 staff did not complete 24 clock hours of annual training for their respective training year. The staff will need to receive make-up training hours that will not count  towards the current training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outline Daily Activities: Three classrooms (Infant Two and Pre-K) do not have activity plans that state the specific daily activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outline Daily Activities (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one lacked the name, address and phone number of the child's doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The Emergency Preparedness Plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Of the 10 children's records evaluated, one lacked the address of the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: There were uncovered outlets in a pre-k classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: A caregiver for a toddler classroom did not know the ages of children she was responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A toddler classroom was of compliance with child/staff ratios. There were 12 children, ages 22 months to 2 years old with one caregiver. The specified age group was 2 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The school-age classroom was not in compliance with the maxium group size. There were 36 children, ages 5-12 years old, with two caregivers. The specified age group was 7 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: The background check staff that is no longer employed by the center was not inactivated within the 7 days. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: The school age chuldren were watching a show that was not educational and not related to planned activities. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: Grass has overgrown the loose-fill surfacing in several areas of the playground; therefore, the loose-fill surfacing is not being maintained at the proper depth of 6 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Three outlet plugs were uncovered, and/or misplaced in the Preschool 3 classroom. The assistant Director was able to replace the outlet covers during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: One child, 12 years of age was observed on the entryway stairs of the school-age area, which was separate from the remainder of the classroom. An 11-year-old child was observed walking from the upstairs area unsupervised, and into the hallway of the main childcare facility. No caregiver was observed with the child, and/or in the hallway.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: One infant, 5 months of age was observed covered with a blanket during naptime. One infant, 12 months of age was observed with a bottle in the crib during naptime.  Caregivers were advised to remove extra objects from all infant cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
